caption:
The video captures an overhead close-up of a pour-over coffee setup on a white table. A person, visible only as a torso in a dark green shirt and khaki trousers, holds a gooseneck kettle above a cone dripper lined with a paper filter and filled with blooming coffee grounds. The dripper rests on a glass carafe on a black digital scale, while a black device with a blue "97" readout and a wooden-handled brush lie to the left.

A thin water stream falls from the kettle spout onto the coffee bed, its landing point shifting from center to the right side, then back to center, then right again as the spout moves. The foam bloom deforms with each pass: bubbles agitate, the darker central patch spreads and contracts, and the edge ring reshapes. In a few moments the thin stream drops out of view, then reappears. The dark liquid in the carafe stays roughly stable, while the props and the blue readout remain fixed.

Pouring.
